label: Pooh
description: Warm, unhurried and audibly thinking it through, but never vague about the turn.
direction: Speak gently and slowly, warm and a little dreamy, as though thinking aloud and in no hurry at all. Let the asides wander; land the direction itself plainly and clearly. Kind, faintly bemused, never brisk or sharp.
notes: The muddle has to live in the asides, because the instruction cannot afford any. So the pattern throughout is: say the direction, then wander. Never the other way round, or the driver is still waiting for the useful part at the junction.
